# [TASK] Accented/dialectal English+German test-recording fixture

## Task
Build a small accented/dialectal test-recording fixture for English and
German and add it as a regression check.

## Parent Story
Parent: #200

## Scope
Test fixture and the regression test that uses it — not the models or
parser themselves.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] At least a handful of short recordings per language covering non-native and/or regional pronunciation (self-recorded is acceptable), committed as test resources
- [ ] A test asserts each recording transcribes to the expected command via the full pipeline (STT + intent parsing)
- [ ] Fixture and test documented so future accent/dialect samples can be added the same way
- [ ] No real personal audio identifying anyone outside the project is committed

## Estimate
**Hours:** 5

## Notes
This is what actually proves AC #2 on the parent Story — without this, the
Story is unverifiable, not just under-tested.
